Extremely Poor Service, Food & Hygiene

One of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had. I have travelled and stayed at many hotels, but I have never experienced such a disappointing level of service.

The staff were not even willing to provide basic drinking water, which is the bare minimum a customer should expect from a hotel. Instead of simply addressing the request, they gave ridiculous and unacceptable excuses for such basic service.

The food quality and taste were also extremely poor. The overall hygiene and service standards were equally disappointing.

What shocked me most was the attitude towards customers. Basic hospitality, courtesy and customer service were completely missing.

This is not about expecting luxury service — it is about expecting basic cleanliness, basic food quality and basic hospitality. Unfortunately, this hotel failed on all three.

I strongly recommend management to seriously review their staff behaviour, hygiene standards and service practices. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

Review: Dining Experience at Hotel Pranav

I would like to share my dining experience at Hotel Pranav.

The location and environment are quiet and pleasant, making it a good place to enjoy breakfast, meals, coffee, or tea with friends, family, or even alone. The availability of safe parking adds convenience, and the order placement and serving services are excellent — staff are friendly and attentive.

I have visited the hotel twice: once for breakfast and once for coffee. Both visits were enjoyable in terms of food and ambiance. However, I faced issues at the billing counter on both occasions. During my first visit, although my payment was successfully completed, I was called back due to a misunderstanding by the billing staff. On my second visit, I had queries regarding the bill, but the staff member’s behavior was unacceptable — she remained engaged in a continuous phone call, failing to prioritize customer concerns and queries.

I sincerely request the hotel management to treat this as a serious concern and take immediate steps to resolve it. Maintaining a respectful and professional relationship between customers and service providers is essential for sustaining business and ensuring its growth.
